subject: english
question:
In the sentence:**
“The stress and pressure linked with clearing such exams often affect students’ mental health negatively,”

which of the following is the **closest synonym** for the word “linked”** as used in the sentence?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. associated with.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"linked"** means connected or related to something. In this sentence, it refers to the connection between stress and the act of clearing exams. (संबंधित)

 
 
• **Example: **The stress and pressure linked with clearing such exams often affect students’ mental health negatively.
 
 
 
• **"Associated with" **is a synonym for linked as it also refers to being connected or related to something. (संबद्ध)
 
 
• **Example: **The health issues are often associated with high levels of stress.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the closest synonym for **'linked' **is **'associated with'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. associated with.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ignored **(नज़रअंदाज़ किया गया): Not paid attention to.

 
 
• **Example:** Her contribution to the project was ignored by the committee.
 
 
 
• **Caused **(कारण बना): Made something happen.
 
 
• **Example:** The heavy rains caused flooding in several areas.
 
 
 
• **Removed** (हटाया गया): Taken away or eliminated.
 
 
• **Example:** The stains were removed using a special cleaner.
